svg.text: ANALOG_TOP (v5) - analog macro of the 8-bit true bottom-plate single-slope ADC: four cells on one shared ramp
SIGNAL FLOW vin -> S0 -> top plate of C_S (54.52 fF) in each cell; S2 opening at TS_k freezes the sample (cells 50 ns apart = 20 MSa/s).
After sampling S1 puts vramp on the top plate; the shared ramp (vrlo -> 2.0 V, 12.8 us) lifts the floating bottom plate, the comparator
fires when it crosses vref (its inp, = vbl), and the std-cell latch turns that into one falling q per conversion: code = floor((t_q - TR) / 50 ns), 8 bits + 20 overrun.
TIMING 20 MHz cnt_clk (TCOUNT 50 ns); ramp_rst HIGH holds vramp at vrlo = 5/33 AVDD (vrlo_ref); the ramp is released >= 300 ns after the last S1 closes (ADR 0018).
SUPPLIES avdd 3.3 V: bias, references, VR_LO, ramp, cells (split per block by the 0 V ammeters VM*); dvdd 3.3 V: the four latches only.
v5 ONE VDD/2 buffer: vref is both the S2 level of every bottom plate and every comparator's inp (midrail_ref, ADR 0021); every analog block inside, no ideal source in the analog path.
L 0.9 um, 4 um fingers, R 5 x
ib diode inside, 11.7 um MIM on out.
vref: S2 track level of every bot
3.44 pF decap; ib = ivrlo from XBG.
(L 8, W 23.91 um, nf 3) into a 44.6 um
MIM (4.0 pF), reset NMOS to vrlo,
XC0..XC3 atop_cell (atop_cell.sch): S0/S1/S2 (sw_sN.sch), 54.52 fF MIM, comparator_d (comparator + its pbias diode,
current input ibias = icmp_k), latch (std cell dfxtn_2) on dvdd; tb: 40 fF on every q (digital capture pins + wire).
Each cell has its own s0_k / s1_k / s2_k: the sampling instant of cell k is the fall of s2_k.

VMBG / VMREF / VMVRLO / VMRAMP / VMC0..3: 0 V ammeters splitting the avdd current per block (i(v.xdut.vmbg) ...), measurement only. Drawing generated by analog_top_sch.py; schematic.sh netlists it, every block below it included, into analog_top.spice (GENERATED).
IN-MACRO OPERATING POINT (op phase, ngspice, typical 27 C, 3.3 V; generated 2026-10-23T09:26Z UTC by op_reduce.py from work/op/ngspice.out (op phase))
States: trk = TS0-10n: every cell tracking; each comparator at its trip point (inn = vref, inp = vbl); ramp = TR+400n: ramp running 8 counts in, cells armed (S1 closed), before cell 0 decides.

Region: sat if |Vds| > Vdsat (inversion by gm/Id: weak > 20, moderate 10-20, strong < 10 /V), else triode; off if Vov <= 0 and |Id| < 1 pA. Vov = |Vgs| - |Vth|. Full table: data/op_point.csv, data/op_rc.csv.
